steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen specified by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title for a create flow.
Choose the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the first instance of the mapped CYLINDER product.
Set the first row quantity requested to 10.
Set the first row delivery location to the specified plant.
Add the same product a second time to exercise duplicate handling.
Set the second duplicate row quantity to match the first row.
Set the second duplicate row to the same delivery location.
Assert that the product remains as two separate sheet rows, which is the retained-duplicate outcome.
